scenario_name: 中等：偏航煞車液壓洩漏 + 變頻器冷卻故障（手冊只寫 See [ABB]），強風

cases.fault_name_zh: 偏航煞車液壓洩漏（細微）
cases.root_cause: 偏航煞車液壓系統密封洩漏：液壓壓力逐日下降，先觸發壓力低警報（260），洩漏偵測線路壓力隨後上升（261）；高風載下偏航滑移、塔架側向負載波動增加，壓力過低時跳機（228）。
cases.root_cause_en: Yaw brake hydraulic seal leakage: system pressure drops day by day, first raising the low-pressure alarm (260), then the leakage-detector line pressurises (261); under high wind load the nacelle slips in yaw, raising tower side-side load fluctuation, and at very low pressure the turbine trips (228).

manual_refs.cause: The pressure of the hydraulic power unit has dropped 10% below nominal value (< 180 bar)
manual_refs.rectification: Check hydraulic power unit. Check yaw brakes for leakage. Fix leakage.

manual_refs.cause: The leakage detector has detected a pressure > 3 bar
manual_refs.rectification: Check yaw brakes for leakage. Fix leakage.

manual_refs.cause: The pressure of the hydraulic power unit has dropped 25% below nominal value (< 150 bar)
manual_refs.rectification: Check hydraulic power unit. Check yaw brakes for leakage. Fix leakage.

expected_actions: 檢查液壓動力單元（手冊）
檢查偏航煞車是否漏油並修漏（手冊）
修復後確認系統壓力回到額定
expected_actions_en: Check the yaw brakes for leakage and fix it (manual).
After repair, verify system pressure is back to nominal.

cases.root_cause: 變頻器 IGCT 水冷系統劣化：O-ring 劣化洩漏使冷卻液位下降，液位過低時冷卻泵空蝕、流量與靜水壓下降，散熱能力下降，冷卻水與變頻器機櫃溫度上升，最後由變頻器要求跳機——冷卻水溫過高（437）或流量很低（439），都伴隨 021。劣化快時多半先到溫度、慢慢洩漏時多半先到流量。
cases.root_cause_en: Converter IGCT water-cooling degradation: O-ring leakage lowers the coolant level; once it is low the cooling pump cavitates, flow and static pressure fall, cooling capacity drops, and cooling-water and cabinet temperatures rise until the converter requests a trip — cooling water temperature very high (437) or flow very low (439), both with 021. A fast degradation usually reaches the temperature first, a slow leak the flow.

manual_refs.cause: A turbine trip request is issued by the converter control system
manual_refs.rectification: This trip comes in combination with a trip in the range 400-700. See [ABB] for troubleshooting

expected_actions: 依 ABB 變頻器手冊檢查冷卻水回路（手冊：Z72 手冊此類事件只寫 See [ABB]）
檢查冷卻液位與洩漏點（O-ring、接頭），補液並修漏
確認冷卻泵與靜水壓恢復正常後再復位
expected_actions_en: Inspect the converter cooling-water circuit per the ABB converter manual (manual: the Z72 manual only says See [ABB]).
Check coolant level and leaks (O-rings, fittings); refill and repair.
Reset only after pump and static pressure are back to normal.
simulation_notes: 流量低 / 很低（422 / 439）的設定值為模擬假設（額定流量的 90 % / 75 %，手冊只寫 See [ABB]）；冷卻水流量沒有 SCADA tag，只看得到冷卻液位、IGCT 水壓與水溫。
simulation_notes_en: The flow low / very low setpoints (422 / 439) are simulator assumptions (90 % / 75 % of rated flow; the manual only says See [ABB]); the cooling water flow has no SCADA tag — only the coolant level, IGCT water pressures and temperature are visible.
